home.problemsTitle:
Good automation
starts with a problem.
home.problemsLead: First we find out what gets in the way of your work. Only then do we choose the technology.

problems.title: Requests get lost between channels
problems.text: Messages arrive in different messengers, by e-mail and through the website. Some never get an answer.

problems.title: Staff spend time on routine
problems.text: Standard replies, copying information, reports and repetitive operations.

problems.title: Clients wait too long
problems.text: The team can't keep up with standard questions, especially outside working hours.

problems.title: Systems work in isolation
problems.text: Data has to be copied between services by hand, which adds errors.

home.approachLead: We don't add complexity for a flashy presentation. A solution should be clear and verifiable.

approach.label: 01 / Understand
approach.title: We study the process
approach.text: We find bottlenecks and define the inputs and the desired result.

approach.label: 02 / Build
approach.title: We assemble the solution
approach.text: We test scenarios and integrate the tool into your usual workflow.

approach.label: 03 / Improve
approach.title: We measure the effect
approach.text: We look at what has changed, fix errors and improve the result.

home.demosTitle:

solutions.title: Services — NQO
solutions.description: Request handling, AI assistants, integrations of CRMs, websites and messengers. We choose tools to fit your process.
solutions.heading: Technology for specific tasks.
solutions.lead: We don't offer “AI for the sake of AI”. We choose tools to fit your process, workload and constraints.
solutions.aside: Three directions that can be combined.

groups.title: Request handling
groups.text: We bring all requests into one flow so that no important request gets lost.

items.title: Collecting requests
items.text: Website, e-mail, forms and messengers in one process.

items.title: Routing
items.text: Each request goes to the right person according to set rules.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: Alerts about new requests and overdue replies.

items.title: Status tracking
items.text: A clear view of what is happening with every request.

groups.title: AI assistants
groups.text: We automate standard conversations and internal requests with clear limits.

items.title: Visitor support
items.text: Answers to frequent questions based on your company's materials.

items.title: Service navigation
items.text: Help choosing a product or the right section of the website.

items.title: Internal assistant
items.text: Finding instructions and giving hints to employees.

items.title: Handover to a person
items.text: Non-standard questions are passed to the responsible specialist.

groups.title: Integrations and processes
groups.text: We connect the tools you already use and remove repeated manual input.

items.title: CRM and forms
items.text: Fields and requests go into the right records.

items.title: Work notifications
items.text: Events from your systems reach the place where your team works.

items.title: Documents and reports
items.text: Standard materials prepared from agreed templates.

items.title: Error control
items.text: Checks and action logs to fix failures quickly.

solutions.note: Specific integrations, cost and limitations are defined after we study your task. Not every process needs AI: sometimes simple automation is enough.

process.title: Approach — NQO
process.description: Five stages of work: diagnosis, design, prototype, implementation and improvement. At every stage you know what is being built and who checks the quality.
process.heading:
A clear process.
A predictable result.
process.lead: At every stage you know what is being built, who checks the quality and what the next step is.
process.aside: From the first conversation to support.

steps.title: Task diagnosis
steps.text: We discuss what is done today, where delays happen and what a successful result looks like.

steps.title: Solution design
steps.text: We define the data, scenarios, constraints, quality criteria and who is responsible for checking.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.text: We build a working scenario and test it on ordinary and difficult examples.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.text: We connect the necessary systems, set up access and explain the workflow to your team.

steps.title: Control and improvement
steps.text: We check how it works, fix errors and gradually optimise the process.

process.principlesTitle:
Control matters more
than pretty magic.

principles.title: People stay in control
principles.text: Complex, risky and unclear cases are passed to an employee for review.

principles.title: Errors can be fixed
principles.text: We plan limits, an action log and a clear way to restore the process.

principles.title: Results are measurable
principles.text: We agree on metrics before implementation instead of promising results without data.

about.title: About — NQO
about.description: NQO — Never Quit Optimizing. We find what can be made simpler, more reliable and clearer in how a business works.
about.heading: Never Quit Optimizing.
about.lead: NQO stands for continuous improvement. Our job is to find what can be made simpler, more reliable and clearer in how a business works.
about.valuesTitle:
Solutions are built
around people and processes.

values.title: Clarity
values.text: Clients should understand what the system does, why, and where its limits are.

values.title: Practicality
values.text: First we look for the real problem and a simple way to solve it. We don't add complexity without need.

values.title: Continuous improvement
values.text: After launch we collect feedback, fix weak spots and develop the product.

about.note: We are a young team from Estonia and work in English, Estonian and Russian. Real cases and reviews will appear here after our first completed projects.
